mainEntity.name: What is the typical sequence for finish carpentry installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical sequence for finish carpentry installation begins after drywall, painting, and flooring preparation are complete. It usually starts with door and window casing, followed by baseboards, crown molding, and then cabinets and built-ins. Interior doors are often hung last to protect them. This order minimizes potential damage to finished surfaces and allows for proper sealing and finishing, ensuring a clean and professional result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry typically follows drywall and painting, starting with door/window casing, then baseboards, crown molding, and finally cabinets and interior doors.
